The Studio

Beauty, handled with care

Asma Parlour was built around a simple idea — that good beauty work comes from listening first. Every visit begins with a short consultation, so what we do matches how you actually want to look and feel, not a trend we're pushing that week.

Our team trains continuously across hair, skin and makeup, and we work with premium, skin-safe products. Tools are sterilised between every client, and each room is kept private and unhurried.

  • Personalised consultation
  • Hygiene-first protocols
  • Experienced specialists
  • Premium product lines
  • Appointment-only privacy
  • Honest, upfront pricing
